title: Everything announced at Made by Google ’26: Pixel 11, Pixel Watch 5, Pixel Tag, and tons of Gemini features
excerpt: Google has just wrapped up its Made by Google 2026 event, unveiling a series of exciting…
body:
Google has just wrapped up its Made by Google 2026 event, unveiling a series of exciting new products and features that are set to redefine its hardware lineup. The tech giant introduced the Pixel 11 series, the Pixel Watch 5, a new tracking device called Pixel Tag, and a host of enhancements to its Gemini AI platform.

What happened

During the event, Google showcased the Pixel 11 series, which includes the Pixel 11 and Pixel 11 Pro. These smartphones are equipped with advanced camera capabilities, improved battery life, and enhanced performance powered by the latest Google Tensor chip. The Pixel 11 Pro, in particular, boasts a new periscope lens that allows for 10x optical zoom, making it a standout in mobile photography.

In addition to the smartphones, Google introduced the Pixel Watch 5, featuring a sleeker design and new health monitoring capabilities. The watch now includes advanced fitness tracking and a longer battery life, making it a more appealing option for health-conscious consumers.

Another significant announcement was the introduction of the Pixel Tag, a new competitor to Apple’s AirTag. This tracking device aims to help users keep tabs on their belongings, integrating seamlessly with Google’s ecosystem. The Pixel Tag is designed to work with the Google Find My Device feature, allowing users to locate lost items easily.

Lastly, Google highlighted various improvements to its Gemini AI platform, which is set to enhance user experience across its devices. These updates include more intuitive voice recognition, better contextual understanding, and expanded capabilities for smart home integration.

Why it matters

The announcements made at the Made by Google 2026 event represent a significant step forward for Google in the competitive tech landscape. The Pixel 11 series, with its cutting-edge camera technology and performance enhancements, positions Google as a serious contender in the smartphone market, particularly against rivals like Apple and Samsung.

The launch of the Pixel Watch 5 also signals Google’s commitment to the wearables market, where it aims to compete with established players. With its focus on health and fitness, the watch could attract a growing segment of consumers interested in health monitoring technologies.

Introducing the Pixel Tag is a strategic move for Google, as it seeks to carve out a niche in the tracking device market, which has been dominated by Apple’s AirTag. By integrating this new product with its existing services, Google can enhance user engagement and loyalty within its ecosystem.

Furthermore, the advancements in the Gemini AI platform underscore Google’s ongoing investment in artificial intelligence, which is becoming increasingly vital across all tech sectors. By improving AI capabilities, Google can offer more personalized and efficient services, further solidifying its position as a leader in technology innovation.

Source: techcrunch.com.
